**Round 58 (owner A, three related items, all on the new grid menu):**
1. **G1 (Medium).** A click on a button outside the open menu closes it **and** presses the button (Snap, Play, Export). Cancelling the press does not stop the click that follows it, so my own round-57 spec contradicted itself.
   - The fix arms a one-time click blocker at the moment the dismissing press is consumed. It removes itself on the click, shortly after the button is released, or on the next press.
   - The task warns A that this cannot live inside the menu component: the menu is gone before the click arrives.
   - It relies on Chrome sending the click in the same step as the release. That only a browser can confirm, which is the job of the new browser check MN-DISMISS-BUTTON.
2. **G6.** The menu closes at every page flip while playing with Follow on. New rule: only scrolls the user makes close it. The fix reuses the test the workspace already applies to tell Follow's scroll from a user scroll, and leaves the existing scroll handler unchanged.
3. **Test-only:** C-R57-01 (focus returns after choosing an item), C-R57-02 (focus returns after the menu is moved, then Escape), and G7 (no menu while the export dialog is open).
